# Wahl — Participative Political Institutions in Pre-Modern Europe

## Source
- Author's data page: https://www.fabianwahl.de/data.html
- Direct downloads (verified 2026-08-10, no registration):
  - https://www.fabianwahl.de/uploads/5/9/4/5/59455913/ppi_data.xlsx
  - https://www.fabianwahl.de/uploads/5/9/4/5/59455913/extended_ppi_database.xlsx

## Citation
Wahl, Fabian. 2015. "Participative Political Institutions in Pre-Modern Europe:
Introducing a New Database." Historical Methods 48(3): 110–124.
(Journal article paywalled; data files are open on the author's site.)

## Files
| File | Description |
|---|---|
| `ppi_data.xlsx` | 104 HRE cities × century years 800–1800 (1,144 rows). Columns: city, year, latitude, longitude, election, guilds_council, burgherrep |
| `extended_ppi_database.xlsx` | Extended version: 325 cities (3,250 rows) incl. Austria, German-speaking Switzerland, Alsace-Lorraine, Low Countries + smaller towns. Columns: city, Century, Coutnry [sic], Latitude, Longitude, Election, Guild Participation Index, Institutionalized Burgher Representation. NOTE: century year 1100 is MISSING in this file |

## What it measures
Century-resolution 0/1 status of three participative institutions: council
elections, guild participation in the council, institutionalized burgher
representation. STATUS PANEL, not grant dates — event studies only at
100-year resolution (same resolution as our population panel, so compatible
with the existing stacked event-study design). Lat/lon included → merges by
coordinates like the other privilege sources.
